```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
})

theme_set(theme_bw())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

ptrap_cols <- c(
  "handwashing p-trap 1" = "#1b9e77",
  "handwashing p-trap 2" = "#d95f02",
  "tap water p-trap" = "#7570b3"
)

ptrap_display_levels <- c(
  "handwashing p-trap 1",
  "handwashing p-trap 2",
  "tap water p-trap"
)

theme_ptrap_like <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey70")
    )
}

timepoint_cols <- c(
  "0h" = "#1b9e77",
  "2h" = "#d95f02",
  "6h" = "#7570b3",
  "12h" = "#e7298a",
  "late centroid" = "#d95f02"
)
```

# Paths

```{r}
code_dir <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
workspace_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(code_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
cache_dir <- path.expand(Sys.getenv(
  "PTRAP_CACHE_DIR",
  unset = file.path(workspace_dir, "cache")
))
output_root <- path.expand(Sys.getenv("PTRAP_OUTPUT_DIR", unset = code_dir))
part1_file <- file.path(cache_dir, "part1_pre_prediction_cache.rds")
out_dir <- file.path(output_root, "final_day_projection")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

stopifnot(file.exists(part1_file))
obj <- readRDS(part1_file)
required <- c("metadata", "vsearch_clr_global_clean", "pca_25_ptrap", "scores_25_ptrap")
missing_req <- setdiff(required, names(obj))
if (length(missing_req) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required objects in part1 cache: ", paste(missing_req, collapse = ", "))
}
metadata <- obj$metadata
vsearch_clr_global_clean <- obj$vsearch_clr_global_clean
pca_25_ptrap <- obj$pca_25_ptrap
scores_25_ptrap <- obj$scores_25_ptrap
```

# Helpers

```{r}
annotate_final_day_samples <- function(meta_tbl) {
  meta_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      is_aug9 = date == as.Date("2024-08-09"),
      has_ampm = str_detect(Sample.Name, regex("am|pm", ignore_case = TRUE)),
      timepoint = case_when(
        is_aug9 & !has_ampm & Phenotype == "PTW" ~ "pre_flush",
        is_aug9 & str_detect(Sample.Name, "_11am\\d?_20240809$") ~ "0h",
        is_aug9 & str_detect(Sample.Name, "_11pm\\d?_20240809$") ~ "12h",
        is_aug9 & str_detect(Sample.Name, "_1pm\\d?_20240809$")  ~ "2h",
        is_aug9 & str_detect(Sample.Name, "_5pm\\d?_20240809$")  ~ "6h",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      time_hours = case_when(
        timepoint == "pre_flush" ~ -0.1,
        timepoint == "0h" ~ 0,
        timepoint == "2h" ~ 2,
        timepoint == "6h" ~ 6,
        timepoint == "12h" ~ 12,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      ptrap_final = case_when(
        !is.na(ptrap) ~ as.numeric(ptrap),
        str_detect(Sample.Name, "_11am1_|_1pm1_|_5pm1_|_11pm1_") ~ 1,
        str_detect(Sample.Name, "_11am2_|_1pm2_|_5pm2_|_11pm2_") ~ 2,
        str_detect(Sample.Name, "_11am3_|_1pm3_|_5pm3_|_11pm3_") ~ 3,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ptrap_final = factor(
        ptrap_final,
        levels = c(1, 3, 2),
        labels = ptrap_display_levels
      ),
      timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre_flush", "0h", "2h", "6h", "12h"))
    )
}

get_prcomp_obj <- function(pca_fit) {
  if (inherits(pca_fit, "prcomp")) return(pca_fit)
  if (is.list(pca_fit) && !is.null(pca_fit$pca) && inherits(pca_fit$pca, "prcomp")) return(pca_fit$pca)
  stop("PCA object is neither a prcomp object nor a list containing $pca")
}

build_sample_feature_matrix <- function(clr_tbl, sample_names, feature_ids = NULL) {
  clr_df <- as.data.frame(clr_tbl)

  # use id column as feature names when available
  if ("id" %in% colnames(clr_df)) {
    rownames(clr_df) <- make.unique(as.character(clr_df$id))
  }

  keep_samples <- intersect(sample_names, colnames(clr_df))
  if (length(keep_samples) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No requested sample names found in CLR table columns.\n",
      "First few requested sample names: ", paste(head(sample_names, 10), collapse = ", "), "\n",
      "First few CLR columns: ", paste(head(colnames(clr_df), 20), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(feature_ids)) {
    keep_features <- intersect(feature_ids, rownames(clr_df))
    if (length(keep_features) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No PCA feature IDs found in CLR table rownames.\n",
        "First few PCA feature_ids: ", paste(head(feature_ids, 10), collapse = ", "), "\n",
        "First few CLR rownames: ", paste(head(rownames(clr_df), 10), collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
    mat <- as.matrix(clr_df[keep_features, keep_samples, drop = FALSE])
    mat <- t(mat)
    mat <- mat[, feature_ids[feature_ids %in% colnames(mat)], drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    mat <- as.matrix(clr_df[, keep_samples, drop = FALSE])
    mat <- t(mat)
  }

  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  mat
}

project_into_existing_pca <- function(prcomp_obj, projection_tbl, sample_names) {
  feature_ids <- rownames(prcomp_obj$rotation)
  x_new <- build_sample_feature_matrix(
    clr_tbl = projection_tbl,
    sample_names = sample_names,
    feature_ids = feature_ids
  )

  proj <- predict(prcomp_obj, newdata = x_new)
  proj <- as.data.frame(proj)
  if (!all(c("PC1", "PC2") %in% names(proj))) names(proj)[1:2] <- c("PC1", "PC2")
  proj$Sample.Name <- rownames(proj)
  as_tibble(proj)
}

compute_late_centroid <- function(scores_df, date_cutoff = as.Date("2024-08-09"), n_recent = 3) {
  scores_df %>%
    mutate(ptrap_chr = as.character(ptrap)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ptrap_chr), !is.na(date), date < date_cutoff) %>%
    group_by(ptrap_chr) %>%
    arrange(desc(date), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_recent) %>%
    summarise(
      late_PC1 = mean(PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
      late_PC2 = mean(PC2, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ptrap_final = recode(ptrap_chr, `1` = "handwashing p-trap 1", `2` = "tap water p-trap", `3` = "handwashing p-trap 2"),
      ptrap_final = factor(ptrap_final, levels = ptrap_display_levels)
    )
}
```

# prepare metadata and samples

```{r}
metadata2 <- annotate_final_day_samples(metadata)

# pre-flush samples already inside original PCA
existing_scores2 <- scores_25_ptrap %>%
  mutate(PCR.cycles = 25) %>%
  left_join(
    metadata2 %>% select(Sample.Name, ptrap_final, timepoint, time_hours),
    by = "Sample.Name"
  )

pre_ref <- existing_scores2 %>%
  filter(timepoint == "pre_flush", !is.na(ptrap_final)) %>%
  select(Sample.Name, PC1, PC2, ptrap_final, timepoint, time_hours)

# timed samples to project (only those actually present in decontam-cleaned global CLR)
all_timed_names <- metadata2 %>%
  filter(
    PCR.cycles == 25,
    Phenotype == "PTW",
    date == as.Date("2024-08-09"),
    timepoint %in% c("0h", "2h", "6h", "12h"),
    !is.na(ptrap_final)
  ) %>%
  pull(Sample.Name) %>%
  unique()

available_timed_names <- intersect(all_timed_names, colnames(vsearch_clr_global_clean))
missing_timed_names <- setdiff(all_timed_names, available_timed_names)

message("Available timed samples in vsearch_clr_global_clean: ", length(available_timed_names))
if (length(missing_timed_names) > 0) {
  message("Missing timed samples: ", paste(missing_timed_names, collapse = ", "))
}
```

# projection

```{r}
pca_obj <- get_prcomp_obj(pca_25_ptrap)

projected <- project_into_existing_pca(
  prcomp_obj = pca_obj,
  projection_tbl = vsearch_clr_global_clean,
  sample_names = available_timed_names
) %>%
  left_join(
    metadata2 %>% select(Sample.Name, ptrap_final, timepoint, time_hours, PCR.cycles),
    by = "Sample.Name"
  ) %>%
  arrange(ptrap_final, time_hours)

late_centroid <- compute_late_centroid(scores_25_ptrap)

projected_with_dist <- projected %>%
  left_join(
    pre_ref %>% select(ptrap_final, pre_PC1 = PC1, pre_PC2 = PC2),
    by = "ptrap_final"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    late_centroid %>% select(ptrap_final, late_PC1, late_PC2),
    by = "ptrap_final"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_to_preflush = sqrt((PC1 - pre_PC1)^2 + (PC2 - pre_PC2)^2),
    distance_to_late_centroid = sqrt((PC1 - late_PC1)^2 + (PC2 - late_PC2)^2)
  )
```

# plots

```{r}
p_time <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = existing_scores2 %>% filter(!is.na(ptrap)),
    aes(PC1, PC2), color = "grey80", size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = pre_ref,
    aes(PC1, PC2), color = "black", size = 2.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = pre_ref,
    aes(PC1, PC2, label = "pre"), nudge_y = 2, size = 3
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = projected,
    aes(PC1, PC2, group = ptrap_final), color = "#1f78b4", linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = late_centroid,
    aes(late_PC1, late_PC2, shape = "late centroid"),
    stroke = 1.1, size = 3.4, color = "#d95f02"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = projected,
    aes(PC1, PC2, color = timepoint), size = 2.4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ ptrap_final, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = timepoint_cols,
    breaks = c("0h", "2h", "6h", "12h")
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("late centroid" = 4), name = NULL) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(order = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(color = "#d95f02"))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = "timepoint"
  )

p_dist <- projected_with_dist %>%
  mutate(ptrap_final = factor(ptrap_final, levels = ptrap_display_levels)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(time_hours, distance_to_late_centroid, color = ptrap_final, group = ptrap_final)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.5, size = 2.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(time_hours, "h")),
    vjust = -0.9, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ptrap_cols, name = "group") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 2, 6, 12), minor_breaks = NULL) +
  labs(
    x = "Hours post-flush",
    y = "Distance to late-stage centroid"
  ) +
  theme_ptrap_like()

```

# Save tables

```{r}
write_csv(
  metadata2 %>%
    filter(PCR.cycles == 25, Phenotype == "PTW", date == as.Date("2024-08-09")) %>%
    select(Sample.Name, ptrap_final, timepoint, time_hours, PCR.cycles),
  file.path(out_dir, "final_day_time_annotations.csv")
)

write_csv(projected, file.path(out_dir, "final_day_projected_scores.csv"))
write_csv(projected_with_dist, file.path(out_dir, "final_day_projected_summary.csv"))
write_csv(pre_ref, file.path(out_dir, "final_day_preflush_reference_points.csv"))
write_csv(late_centroid, file.path(out_dir, "final_day_late_centroids.csv"))

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "final_day_projected_pca_trajectory.pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
print(p_time)
dev.off()

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "final_day_projected_distance_recovery.pdf"), width = 9, height = 5)
print(p_dist)
dev.off()

saveRDS(
  list(
    projected = projected,
    projected_with_dist = projected_with_dist,
    pre_ref = pre_ref,
    late_centroid = late_centroid,
    available_timed_names = available_timed_names,
    missing_timed_names = missing_timed_names
  ),
  file.path(out_dir, "final_day_projected_objects.rds")
)

message("Done. Outputs written to: ", out_dir)
```
